# Uncodemy

> > Uncodemy is a technology training platform offering professional courses in Data Analytics, Data Science, AI, Web Development, and software tools across India with placement assistance.

Uncodemy provides hands-on certification courses in Python, SQL, R, Machine Learning, Angular, AutoCAD, and Advanced Excel across multiple Indian cities. The platform emphasizes career development through live projects, internships, and job placement support.

## Key Topics

- Data Analytics Training
- Python & SQL
- Machine Learning
- Data Science
- Artificial Intelligence
- Placement Assistance
- Data Visualization
- Career Bootcamp
- Angular & JavaScript
- Web Development
- Hands-on Projects
- Certification Courses
- R & NoSQL
- Advanced Excel
- Job Placement Support
